text: 读者可以在个案里看到，我所了解的绝大多数小姐，在平时和"上班"时，都是判若两人。
en: Readers can see in the case studies that the vast majority of sex workers I know are like different people when off-duty and when 'at work'.

en: For example, A-Xin (hair-salon girl 09) is a bit odd precisely because she is the reverse.

en: When among the group of sex workers, she chatters and jokes and says somewhat out-of-line things, yet facing clients she seems all solemn.

text: 其实，这也是职业化，有点像警察，平时尽可以打打闹闹，执行公务的时候却必须不苟言笑。
en: In fact, this too is professionalisation, a bit like the police, who may mess around normally but must be serious when carrying out duties.

text: 职业化的小姐，把嫖客仅仅看作是一只一只的钱包，绝不会把他视为一个活生生的人。

en: As far as I know, the most important reason ordinary women cannot understand or accept sex workers is this: 'A woman must like a man before she can go to bed with him, or at least not dislike him.

en: In the case studies I have collected, readers can see that when the vast majority of sex workers talk about their clients or the men who keep them, they always first state his status — for example whether he is from Hong Kong, what he does, and so on.

en: Because, whether a black wallet or a white wallet, the one that is willing to pull out money is a good wallet.

en: That is to say, at the moment that ordinary women see as one of perfect union of body and soul and total ease, she must completely separate her spirit from her flesh.

en: Yet after sex workers finished, they all hurriedly left the hotel, circled outside, then came back and sat down to chat with other sex workers.

text: 灵肉分离为什么是小姐职业化程度的最根本的标志呢？

text: 那么，不是那么职业化的小姐，是不是就像传统观念里的一样，完全没有羞耻感呢？
en: So, are sex workers who are not so professionalised, just as in traditional notions, completely without a sense of shame?

text: 显然，小姐也是人，尤其是没有那么职业化的小姐，在某些方面还是会有羞耻感的(当然，这也只是举了部分例子）
en: Clearly, sex workers are also human; especially those not so professionalised still have a sense of shame in some respects (of course, this only gives some examples).

text: 在发廊妹里，就连肯"吹箫"（女对男口交）的也不多。
en: Among hair-salon girls, even those willing to 'blow the flute' (fellatio, woman on man) are few.

text: 萍姐说过："S区有十几个‘吹’（箫）的。
en: Ping Jie said: 'In District S there are a dozen or so who 'blow' (the flute).

text: 我过去的发廊里有 4个，算多的。
en: In my former salon there were 4, which counts as many.

text: 一般的发廊里只有不到三分之一。
en: In an ordinary salon there are fewer than one third.

text: "我问萍姐，为什么有的小姐"吹"有的却不"吹"？
en: "I asked Ping Jie, why do some sex workers 'blow' and others do not?"

text: 她总结为：（1）相貌差的才吹；（2）为了生意更多才吹，而不是为了提高单价，因为吹的价钱与打炮是一样的；（3）这样的小姐在自己的男朋友那里也不吹。
en: She summarised: (1) only those with poor looks blow; (2) they blow to get more business, not to raise the unit price, because the price for blowing is the same as for 'firing the cannon'; (3) such sex workers also do not blow for their own boyfriends.

text: 总而言之，萍姐把"吹箫"视为下流无耻的事情，因此只有等而下之的人，在万般无奈情况下才会去做。
en: In sum, Ping Jie regards 'blowing the flute' as vulgar and shameless, so only those of the lowest sort, in utter helplessness, would do it.

text: 据我所知，她的这种看法，在小姐里非常普遍
en: As far as I know, this view of hers is very common among sex workers.

text: 那么为什么会这样呢？
en: So why is it like this?

text: 在1997年的考察中，我只认识到：小姐其实只是在性关系道德方面"开放"了一个口子，可以向任何人出租自己的性器官。
en: In the 1997 fieldwork, I only realised this: sex workers have merely 'opened' a breach in the morality of sexual relations, and can rent out their sexual organs to anyone.

text: 但是在性行为道德和性技巧方面,她们实际上非常传统，非常保守；所以不肯去做"脏""丑"之事。
en: But in the morality of sexual acts and sexual technique, they are in fact very traditional, very conservative; so they refuse to do 'dirty' and 'ugly' things.

text: 直到1998年，由于个案积累得多了，我才悟出：这其实是一个有没有交换自觉的问题。
en: It was only in 1998, as case studies accumulated, that I realised: this is actually a question of whether there is a conscious awareness of exchange.

text: 如果一个小姐仍然把身体看作是自己心系其中的肉身，是灵魂的寓所，而不是生产资料，那么她就不可能因为"吹箫"而玷污它；不可能像开机器那样去使用它。
en: If a sex worker still regards the body as the flesh in which her heart resides, the abode of the soul, rather than as a means of production, then she cannot defile it through 'blowing the flute'; she cannot use it like operating a machine.

text: 而且，即使在"打炮"这样的"正常出租"中，她也会产生屈辱感这样的非职业化的东西。
en: Moreover, even in 'firing the cannon', this 'normal rental', she will produce unprofessional things like a sense of humiliation.

text: 3.婚姻家庭 个人认为，婚姻中的一方出去嫖的原因在于另一方的吸引力下降，这种情况下，哪怕你把全世界的性工作者都查封掉，ta也一定不会停止躁动的，大概率会转化成yp等形式，根本原因并不在于小姐。
en: 3. Marriage and family. Personally, I think the reason one party in a marriage goes out to patronise prostitutes lies in the decline of the other party's attractiveness; in such a case, even if you shut down all sex workers in the world, they would certainly not stop their restlessness, and would most likely convert it into forms such as one-night stands — the root cause is not the sex workers.

text: 那么，妓女究竟危害了社会的什么呢？
en: So, what exactly of society do prostitutes harm?

text: 如果说是危害了婚姻家庭，那可就太孤陋寡闻了。
en: If you say they harm marriage and the family, that would be too ill-informed.

text: 至少广东的许多妇女已经明白了：她们的丈夫既不会一辈子住在发廊里，也不会真的明媒正娶一个小姐。
en: At least many women in Guangdong have understood: their husbands will neither live in hair salons all their lives, nor truly marry a sex worker through proper matchmaking.

text: 她们的大敌是形形色色的"二奶"，而且不仅仅是那些从小姐升上来的女人，更是那些从来没有做过小姐，却径直成为"二奶"的女人。
en: Their great enemy is all sorts of 'mistresses', and not only those women who rose from being sex workers, but even more those women who never were sex workers yet became 'mistresses' directly.

text: 还有，如果嫖客无婚（未婚、离异、丧偶），小姐又怎么可能去危害他的婚姻家庭呢？
en: Moreover, if a client is unmarried (never married, divorced, or widowed), how could a sex worker possibly harm his marriage and family?

text: 哪个男人因为嫖娼就一辈子不结婚，恐怕找不到多少这样的证据；反而是大多数小姐却因此很难顺利结婚，甚至因此不得不离婚。
en: As for which man, because of patronising prostitutes, never marries for life — I'm afraid not much evidence can be found; on the contrary, most sex workers, because of this, find it hard to marry smoothly, and even are forced to divorce because of it.

text: 怎么就没人来大声疾呼"保护她们的婚姻家庭"呢？
en: Why is no one loudly calling for 'protecting their marriage and family'?

text: 还要把她们抓起来，使得她们更难结婚或者更难维持婚姻。
en: Yet they are arrested, making it even harder for them to marry or to maintain a marriage.

text: 当然，历来统治阶层一直认为，妓女危害的是社会道德风尚;因此嫖娼卖淫一直被视为"风化罪"。
en: Of course, throughout history the ruling class has always held that prostitutes harm social morality and mores; therefore patronising prostitutes and prostitution have always been regarded as 'crimes against public decency'.

text: ②但这种"唯道德主义"的法理显然已经患了老年痴呆症。
en: ② Yet this 'moralistic' jurisprudence has clearly contracted senile dementia.

text: 人们早已对它提出两点质疑：第一，道德，难道是你该管的吗？
en: People have long raised two doubts about it: first, morality — is it yours to police?

text: 第二，道德，凭什么由你定？
en: Second, morality — by what right do you define it?

text: 法律规范的应当是社会成员的行为底线，而不是道德水准。
en: What the law should regulate is the baseline of conduct of social members, not their level of morality.

text: 说穿了，妓女不在于危害了社会的什么，而在于危害了什么人的社会。
en: To put it plainly, the prostitute is not a matter of what of society she harms, but of whose society she harms.

text: 不害人就是好人。
en: One who does not harm others is a good person.

text: 我们干吗非要跟着别人去害那些并不害人的而且我们其实并不了解的人呢？
en: Why must we follow others in harming those who do not harm others, and whom we in fact do not understand?

text: 最后也就是讨论性能不能商品化了。
en: Finally, it comes to discussing whether sex can be commodified.

text: 以上例子其实也说明了，一个职业化的小姐，出卖的并不是性，因为她近乎于体会不到任何的性快感，只是在出租自己的器官，出卖自己的劳动力而已。
en: The examples above in fact also show that a professionalised sex worker does not sell sex, because she can barely experience any sexual pleasure; she merely rents out her organs and sells her labour.

text: 那么假设真的出卖的就是性呢？
en: Then what if what is really sold is sex?

text: 潘是这样看待的
en: This is how Pan views it:

text: 最近几年来，随着大众传媒开始报道某些少女学生的“援交”（就是卖淫），中国人不得不思考一些其实非常古老的问题：为什么性只要一跟钱沾上边就不道德了呢？
en: In recent years, as the mass media began reporting on 'compensated dating' (that is, prostitution) among some schoolgirls, Chinese people have been forced to think about some actually very ancient questions: why is it that as soon as sex gets tangled up with money, it becomes immoral?

text: 为什么要房要车要存款的结婚就不是性呢？
en: Why is a marriage that demands a house, a car and savings not sex?

text: 为什么人们总是盯着女性的卖，好像有男性从来都不卖似的？
en: Why do people always fix their eyes on women's selling, as if men never sold?

text: 其实对于“性可以买卖”的社会恐惧，仅仅来自人类捍卫自己那残存的最后一点自尊心的背水一战。
en: In fact, the social fear of 'sex being bought and sold' comes merely from humanity's last-ditch defence of the last remnant of its self-esteem.

text: 在历史上，哥白尼已经把我们视为母亲的地球“贬低”为宇宙的沧海一粟；达尔文又把我们奉若神明的列祖列宗“贬低”为猿；弗洛伊德再把我们引以为豪的精神世界“贬低”为潜意识；爱因斯坦更是把我们安身立命于斯的时间与空间“贬低”为相对的不可靠。
en: In history, Copernicus 'demoted' the Earth, which we regarded as our mother, to a drop in the ocean of the universe; Darwin 'demoted' our revered ancestors to apes; Freud 'demoted' our proud spiritual world to the subconscious; and Einstein went further and 'demoted' the time and space in which we settle and live to relative untrustworthiness.

text: 因此，除了性爱，我们还有什么可以证明自己这个物种的存在价值？
en: Therefore, apart from sexual love, what else do we have to prove the existential value of our species?

text: 与此同时，在滚滚凡尘之中，我们生活的几乎一切内容也已经被商品化了，而且几乎都是非“我”所愿。
en: At the same time, in the rolling mundane world, almost every aspect of our lives has already been commodified, and almost all of it against 'my' will.

text: 于是性爱就不得不成为至高无上的精神家园。
en: Thus sexual love has had to become the supreme spiritual homeland.

text: 这一切，在西方至少经历了两百年的发展进程，但是在中国却如同“飞来横祸”。
en: All this, in the West, has undergone a process of development of at least two hundred years, but in China it arrived like 'a sudden calamity from heaven'.

text: 中国人的焦虑怎么可能不更加严重？
en: How could Chinese people's anxiety not be even more severe?

text: 随之，我们的自信心也正在土崩瓦解。
en: Thereupon, our self-confidence is also crumbling.

text: 按理说，不管别人怎么买卖性，只要自己不去做，不就可以了吗？
en: By rights, no matter how others buy and sell sex, as long as one does not do it oneself, isn't that enough?

text: 可是不，相当多的人却非要“各人自扫门前雪，专管他人床上事”。
en: But no — quite a lot of people insist on 'sweeping the snow from their own doorstep while specialising in managing others' bedroom affairs'.

text: 这种本来非常可以理解的个人的情感体验，被社会制度趁热打铁地挑动成形形色色的道德义愤，被牢牢捆绑在某种大目标的战车之上。
en: This originally very understandable personal emotional experience is, by the social system, struck while the iron is hot into all sorts of moral indignation, and firmly bound to the war chariot of some grand objective.

text: 性的买卖，不是一个分清是非就能够解决的问题，而是一个接受不接受多元化社会的问题。
en: The buying and selling of sex is not a problem that can be solved merely by distinguishing right from wrong; it is a question of whether one accepts a pluralistic society.

text: 性的买卖，至少在当下的中国也不是一个可以理性讨论的问题，而是一个应该不应该“我活，也让别人活”的人生信仰的问题。
en: The buying and selling of sex, at least in present-day China, is also not a question that can be discussed rationally, but a question of the life belief of whether one should 'live oneself, and let others live'.

text: 在逻辑上，接受一种社会现象绝对不等于赞成或者支持之，更不等于自己也要这样做。
en: Logically, accepting a social phenomenon is absolutely not the same as approving or supporting it, still less the same as doing it oneself.

text: 接受还有许多不同的程度，例如，从不闻不问，到见怪不怪，再到仅仅是不破口大骂，都可以算作某种程度的接受。
en: Acceptance also has many different degrees — for example, from taking no notice, to being unfazed by the strange, to merely not cursing out loud — all can count as a certain degree of acceptance.

text: 可是中国人在“大一统”的世界中生活惯了，被驱使着去追求“道德洁癖”，好像如果我骂得还不够狠，就足以证明我自己也这样干过。
en: Yet Chinese people, accustomed to living in a world of 'great unity', are driven to pursue 'moral cleanliness', as if if I do not curse harshly enough, that would be sufficient proof that I too have done such things.

text: 因此，几乎人人都必须“表态”，一个比一个偏激，直至形成“文革”那样的全民癫狂。
en: Therefore, almost everyone must 'take a stance', each more extreme than the last, until a nationwide frenzy like the 'Cultural Revolution' is formed.

text: 这就是本书早早就开始讨论“制度的情感动力”的原因。
en: This is why this book began early on to discuss the 'emotional dynamics of institutions'.

text: 性的买卖，只能从性的人权的角度来解决。
en: The buying and selling of sex can only be resolved from the angle of sexual human rights.

text: 只不过“我的身体我做主”这一革命思想，已经用不着笔者再来重复了，因为赞成的人早已自我实践了，而且在社会舆论中正在占有越来越多的份额。
en: It is just that the revolutionary idea of 'my body, my choice' need not be repeated by the author, because those who agree have long since practised it themselves, and are occupying an ever-larger share in public opinion.

text: 至于那些反对的人，虽然他们作为多元之一和言论自由的主体，有权大声疾呼，但是笔者的态度是“道不同，不相为谋”。
en: As for those who oppose, although as one of the pluralities and as subjects of freedom of speech they have the right to speak out loudly, the author's attitude is 'those whose paths differ do not plot together'.

text: 只要双方都在人权的范围之内，那就再各说各话几十年吧。
en: So long as both sides remain within the bounds of human rights, then let each speak their own piece for a few more decades.
